description: Edge-case battery. Tick 2 is OUT OF ORDER (tsMs 1500 < prior 2000) but in the same open bucket, so it accumulates correctly and only bumps the out-of-order counter. Tick 4 is an EXACT DUPLICATE of tick 3 (same ts/price/qty/aggressor) and counts as a real trade while bumping the duplicate counter. Bar 0 trades, bar 1 (bucketTs 60000) is EMPTY (gap), bar 2 (bucketTs 120000) trades — CVD must step only on bars that traded. A tick lands exactly on the 120000 boundary and belongs to bar 2.
